parsed.reply: No, «producir comezón» is not an error at all. In Mexico and several other Latin American countries, «comezón» is the standard word for an itch, so «producir comezón» is a very natural dictionary definition for what the verb «picar» means in its intransitive sense (when something causes an itch).
followUps: Add an example for the spicy sense
